newsitem.title: UK: BTR shares bounce back in strong volume.
newsitem.headline: BTR shares bounce back in strong volume.

text.p: Shares in diversified conglomerate BTR Plc gained ground on Tuesday as investors moved into the stock in the belief it had fallen far enough in recent weeks, dealers said.
"They are due a bounce," one dealer said. "They were hammered last week and it might be time to get back in."
The shares were 6-1/2p higher at 198 at 0900 GMT in volume of 10.7 million. They fell to 180p on June 10, their lowest level in more than two years.
"They have been very weak recently and it's not surprising to see a bit of buying at these levels," a market-maker said.
